(This matches story’s REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS and the config example in the story.)
Helper module for boundaries and security: - src/rules/helpers/valid-story-reference-helpers.ts - JSDoc header ties to story 006.0. - analyzeCandidateBoundaries(candidates, cwd): - Uses enforceProjectBoundary(candidate, cwd) for each candidate. - Returns { hasInProjectCandidate, hasOutOfProjectCandidate } (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - handleProjectBoundaryForExistence(...): - If all candidates are out-of-project, calls reportInvalidPath and returns true, short-circuiting further checks. - If existenceResult.matchedPath exists but lies outside project, reports invalidPath and returns true. - Ensures resolved story files outside project root are never treated as valid (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY). - performSecurityValidations(...): - Rejects absolute paths when allowAbsolute is false via reportInvalidPath and returns false. - For paths including traversal components or separators, resolves via path.resolve(cwd, storyPath) and rejects if resolved path does not start with cwd + path.sep. - Satisfies REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION (path traversal and absolute-path prevention).
Filesystem and path utilities: - src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts - File-level JSDoc references story 006.0 and requirements for path resolution, file existence, security, error handling, and performance. - enforceProjectBoundary(candidate, cwd): - Normalizes cwd and candidate with path.resolve and checks candidate is equal to or begins with cwd + path.sep. - Returns { candidate: normalizedCandidate, isWithinProject } (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY). - buildStoryCandidates(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs): - For paths starting with "./" or "../", returns [path.resolve(cwd, storyPath)]. - For other paths, builds candidates: - path.resolve(cwd, storyPath). - For each dir in storyDirectories, path.resolve(cwd, dir, path.basename(storyPath)). - This matches story’s path-resolution rules: project root via cwd and configurable directories (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - fileExistStatusCache: Map caches existence results (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION). - checkSingleCandidate(candidate): - Uses cache; if no cache entry, runs fs.existsSync and fs.statSync inside try/catch. - Returns: - status "missing" if not exists or not a regular file. - status "exists" if isFile(). - status "fs-error" with error captured if any fs call throws. - Never throws to callers, achieving REQ-ERROR-HANDLING. - getStoryExistence(candidates): - Iterates candidates via checkSingleCandidate. - On first "exists", returns { candidates, status: "exists", matchedPath }. - If no exists candidates but at least one fs-error, returns { candidates, status: "fs-error", error }. - Otherwise returns { candidates, status: "missing" }. - Satisfies REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION. - storyExists(paths): boolean wrapper that returns true only if getStoryExistence reports "exists". - normalizeStoryPath(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs): - Uses buildStoryCandidates and getStoryExistence and returns { candidates, exists, existence } (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - Security helpers: - isAbsolutePath, containsPathTraversal, isTraversalUnsafe, hasValidExtension, isUnsafeStoryPath enforce absolute-path and traversal rules and .story.md extension (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION). - __resetStoryExistenceCacheForTests() clears the cache, enabling isolated test scenarios (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION, testing support).

traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION are satisfied by the current implementation. Clear, specific diagnostics are provided for missing files, invalid extensions, invalid paths, and filesystem access errors, fulfilling the User Experience and Error Handling criteria. The associated Jest and RuleTester test suites in tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts are explicitly traced to this story and comprehensively exercise the required behaviours, including configuration, boundary conditions, and filesystem error scenarios.
